description: Turn a monthly volume of a task into monthly and annual cost, for a person and for the AI employee, in one market. Use this when someone asks what a workload costs them per year, or what they would save.

taskId.description: Task id from `list_work_tasks`. One of: invoice-entry, lead-callback, appointment-rescue, review-reply, receivables-chase, returns-case, cod-confirmation, customer-winback, supplier-price-check, quote-build, shift-schedule, candidate-screening, service-followup.

unitsPerMonth.description: How many units of this task happen per month, e.g. 120 invoices.

name: estimate_annual_cost
title: Annualise a task volume
